text:
What is meant by induced magnetism?
A
the force of attraction between the N pole of one magnet and the S pole of a different magnet
B
the force of repulsion between the N poles of two magnets
C
when a material placed in a magnetic field becomes a permanent magnet
D
when a material placed in a magnetic field becomes a temporary magnet
